tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Primary tool for answering natural-language questions over indexed website and landing-page content. tools.name: get_chunk
tools.description: Retrieve one concrete indexed chunk by uid, or by documentId plus chunkIndex. Optionally returns adjacent chunks from the same document for context.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Reconstruct a page by documentId or url. Returns chunks ordered by chunkIndex plus a compact heading structure.

tools.name: get_source_map
tools.description: Build a navigable map of an indexed source or domain with pages, documents, headings, and chunk ranges.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List indexed pages available within a sourceId or domain. Use this to discover which page URLs/documents exist before requesting a full page.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Discovery tool for indexed brands, sites, and domains. tools.name: find_pages_by_title
tools.description: Resolve the most relevant indexed pages by approximate title match before doing a narrower content search. Use this when the user mentions a brand, product family, or page-like concept but not a domain or URL, and you want to identify the right page first without requiring an exact title match.

tools.name: compare_content
tools.description: Compare two or more named items, product formats, ranges, topics, or alternatives using indexed website content. tools.name: find_product_mentions
tools.description: Specialized product extraction tool. tools.name: find_content_assets
tools.description: Extract image/media asset URLs from indexed markdown text. tools.name: match_almax_prompt
tools.description: Classify a Spanish prompt or phrase related to Almax into the closest editorial intent from the corpus. Use this when the client needs to detect which predefined Almax topic a user sentence matches before routing to another tool or template.
